backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles with access control, allowing creation, retrieval, and admin-managed subscription tier updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and functionality of key frontend components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light and dark theme color variables and base UI styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the root React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router configuring public, protected, and Stripe return routes with authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/ai/AICaptionGene: UI component for generating and copying templated social media captions with customizable inputs.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeCh: Dashboard UI for configuring and validating Stripe checkout and return URLs with save feedback.
frontend/src/components/billing/UpgradeT: UI card for showing current subscription tier and enabling Stripe-based upgrade to Pro.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout wrapping header, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer displaying copyright, branding, and a referral link.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with logo, navigation, and Internet Identity login/logout handling.
frontend/src/config/stripeCheckoutConfig: Utility for storing, validating, and retrieving Stripe checkout configuration from localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication state and lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for loading, creating, and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus CSS variables defining theme and color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point wiring React Query and Internet Identity provider around the root component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page showing user profile, subscription tier, AI tools, and refresh controls with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with hero marketing content, feature highlights, and authentication-based CTA buttons.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page using Internet Identity for authentication with loading, error handling, and redirect on success.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentCancelPage.tsx: Displays a payment-canceled message and provides actions to retry or return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows payment success confirmation and a button to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/utils/captionGenerator.ts: Generates three AI-style caption suggestions based on topic, tone, platform, and keywords using templates, emojis, and CTAs.
frontend/src/utils/subscriptionTier.ts: Utility functions for mapping subscription tiers to labels and checking free/pro status.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage hash-based query cleanup. Includes helpers for retrieving, storing, clearing, and prioritizing URL or session values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, content paths, theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugins. Sets up a luxury-style design system with extended shadows, typography, and container settings.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s schema, current state, goals, architectural notes, and implemented features. Serves as a structured description of the app’s scope and progress.
